description: A badge pinned to a TabBarItem's icon: a count (shown as "99+" above 99) or a dot, and what it means (label, read after the tab's own label: "Inbox, 3 new"). Purely decorative otherwise.

constructors.description: A badge of count or a dot, meaning label.

params.name: count
params.description: Shown as "99+" above 99; ignored when dot is true.

params.name: dot
params.description: A plain dot instead of a count.

params.name: label
params.description: What the badge means, read after the tab's own label.
